newsitem.title: CHINA: China declares six days of mourning for Deng.
newsitem.headline: China declares six days of mourning for Deng.

text.p: China has declared six days of mourning for paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, the Foreign Ministry announced on Thursday.
The Foreign Ministry announced the mourning period was from Thursday to February 25.

The funeral would likely be on February 25 based on the mourning period and past practice. China has yet to announce a date for the funeral. The report did not say whether Deng's body would lie in state.
Deng died late on Wednesday of respiratory failure. He was 92 and in the advanced stages of Parkinson's disease.
